---
title: "07 - Niches"
subtitle: "BANKSY niches per sample, matched into niche types"
---

```{r}
source("_helpers.R")
source("_figures.R")
bk_f <- find_tab("^banksy_summary\\.csv$")
nc_f <- find_tab("^niche_by_celltype\\.csv$")
ns_f <- find_tab("^niche_by_sample\\.csv$")
nc <- read_files(nc_f, colClasses = c(lambda = "character"))
ns <- read_files(ns_f, colClasses = c(lambda = "character"))
lambdas <- if (!is.null(nc)) sort(unique(nc$lambda)) else character()
n_types <- function(l) length(unique(nc[lambda == l & startsWith(column, "niche_type"), niche]))
## A niche map's kind and lambda as a tab name ##
map_kind <- function(k) {
  lam <- sub("^.*_lam", "", k)
  what <- c(niche_type = "Niche types", niche_sample = "Each sample's niches", niche_id = "Joint niches")
  w <- what[sub("_lam.*$", "", k)]
  paste0(ifelse(is.na(w), sub("_lam.*$", "", k), w), ", lambda ", lam)
}
```

BANKSY finds niches in each sample from each cell's own expression and its neighbours'. Niches whose cell-type mixes match across samples become one niche type.

```{r}
page_top(
  stages = "spatial",
  Input = "The annotate object, its <code>celltype_column</code>, and the <code>banksy_settings</code> row of <code>banksy_variants</code>.",
  Method = "BANKSY per sample at each lambda of <code>banksy_lambda_ladder</code>, Leiden at <code>banksy_sample_res</code>, then niches matched into types when their cell-type mixes correlate above 1 minus <code>banksy_match_cut</code>.",
  Output = "The <code>niche_sample_lam</code> and <code>niche_type_lam</code> columns on the spatial object, and the tables in <code>tables/07_spatial/banksy</code>."
)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(render_tree(list(
  "Settings and counts" = function() {
    tagList(plain_table(read_files(bk_f, colClasses = c(lambda = "character"))), csv_links(bk_f))
  },
  "Cell types in each niche type" = function() {
    if (is.null(nc)) return(missing_note("No niches yet."))
    items <- lapply(lambdas, function(l) {
      rfig(paste0("niche_types_cells_", l), c(nc_f, RUN$label_colours), function() {
        d <- nc[lambda == l & startsWith(column, "niche_type")]
        d[, share := n_cells / sum(n_cells), by = niche]
        d[, niche := factor(niche, rev(niche_levels(niche)))]
        d[, cell_type := factor(cell_type, label_levels(cell_type, STYLE))]
        heat_plot(d, "cell_type", "niche", "share", name = "Share of the\nniche's cells") +
          scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) display_name(x, STYLE))
      }, heat_size(length(unique(nc$cell_type)), n_types(l))[["w"]], heat_size(length(unique(nc$cell_type)), n_types(l))[["h"]] + 0.6)
    })
    tagList(
      rpicker(stats::setNames(items, paste("Lambda", lambdas))),
      tags$p(class = "table-note", "Each niche type's cells by cell type, as shares of the niche type."),
      tab("^niche_types\\.csv$", colClasses = c(lambda = "character"), note = "Each sample's niches, matched across samples into types by their cell-type mix."),
      csv_links(c(nc_f, find_tab("^niche_type_vs_merged\\.csv$|^banksy_genes\\.csv$")))
    )
  },
  "Niche types per sample" = function() {
    if (is.null(ns)) return(missing_note("No niches yet."))
    items <- lapply(lambdas, function(l) {
      rfig(paste0("niche_types_samples_", l), ns_f, function() {
        d <- ns[lambda == l & startsWith(column, "niche_type")]
        d[, share := n_cells / sum(n_cells), by = sample]
        lv <- niche_levels(d$niche)
        d[, `:=`(niche = factor(niche, lv), sample = factor(sample, rev(sample_levels(sample))))]
        ggplot(d, aes(share, sample, fill = niche)) +
          geom_col(width = 0.8, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = niche_colours(lv), name = NULL, guide = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
          scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.01))) +
          labs(x = "Share of the sample's cells", y = NULL) +
          theme_report()
      }, 8, 1.4 + 0.42 * length(unique(ns$sample)))
    })
    tagList(
      rpicker(stats::setNames(items, paste("Lambda", lambdas))),
      csv_links(ns_f)
    )
  },
  "Niche maps" = function() {
    f <- figs("07_spatial/banksy", "^niche_spatial_.+\\.png$", FALSE)
    if (!length(f)) return(missing_note("No niche maps yet."))
    kind <- sub("^niche_spatial_.+?_(niche_[a-z]+_lam[0-9.]+)\\.png$", "\\1", basename(f))
    smp <- sub("^niche_spatial_(.+?)_niche_[a-z]+_lam[0-9.]+\\.png$", "\\1", basename(f))
    ks <- unique(kind)
    ks <- ks[order(!startsWith(ks, "niche_type"), ks)]
    tabs(setNames(lapply(ks, function(k) figure_picker(f[kind == k], smp[kind == k])), map_kind(ks)))
  },
  ".pipeline" = function() pipeline_figures(figs("07_spatial/banksy", "heatmap.+\\.png$", FALSE)),
  "Parameters" = function() {
    params_table(c("banksy_settings", "banksy_hvgs", "banksy_bg_mult", "banksy_lambda_ladder", "banksy_sample_res",
                   "banksy_match_cut", "niche_map_focus"), "spatial")
  }
)))
```
